source: Original v5 low-loss pair, 198.6m reused plus 190/180/146.4m new pairs
processing: Actual source and Yee time offsets; complex H1-H0; no tail taper, AGC, background removal, amplitude/phase/delay fit or per-column normalization
gates: Frozen local primary peak +-12ns and +-60ns at new sites; existing anchor basal gate and +-60ns; additionally common 180-450ns for unguided primary-range peaks
correlation: abs(vdot(a,b))/(norm(a)*norm(b)); descriptive phase-shape agreement, not energy fraction or fitted field calibration
arrival_template: Same low-loss complex Fresnel/phase95 bistatic local-plane primary; includes neither spreading, full slope/angle spectrum, nonlocal return, internal multiples, nor full discrete-interface theory
figures: Shared absolute grayscale signed H1/H0/delta; four configuration columns labelled unequal station separation; additionally physical x-grid sparse B-scan with every uncomputed 0.2m trace masked, no interpolation; per-station envelopes and model peak markers
limits: No blind event detector, finite3D or field certification. Low-loss counterfactual is not production material. Spatial stations change local thickness/slope and relative domain-boundary distances together. Four sites do not establish full-line convergence.
